headline: Anti-greenwashing directive applies alongside Chinese labour complaints and machinery updates
summary: The EU's Empowering Consumers directive has entered into application, restricting generic environmental claims on consumer tools and batteries. Meanwhile, formal worker complaints over Chinese factory overtime raise due diligence risks, and technical corrections were issued for the upcoming Machinery Regulation.

items.title: Anti-greenwashing directive enters into application across the EU
items.what: The Empowering Consumers for the Green Transition Directive has taken effect, banning unsubstantiated environmental claims, generic green marketing phrases, and non-certified sustainability labels.
items.meaning: Consumer-facing claims for power tools, garden equipment, and battery platforms must be backed by certified evidence or withdrawn immediately.
items.action: Audit packaging, manuals, and online marketing to remove generic claims such as 'eco-friendly' or uncertified battery green labels.

sources.title: New EU Anti-Greenwashing Rules Enter into Force

items.title: Chinese manufacturing labour complaints submitted to the EU
items.what: Chinese factory workers have submitted complaints to EU authorities alleging excessive overtime and severe working conditions in mainland manufacturing facilities.
items.meaning: With roughly 200 suppliers in China, this heightens scrutiny under forced labour enforcement and increases audit rigor needed for CSRD workforce disclosures.
items.action: Review supplier audit records specifically for working hours, overtime compliance, and wage deductions across your Chinese supplier base.

sources.title: Brutale Überstunden-Kultur: Chinas Arbeiter beschweren sich bei der EU

items.title: Machinery Regulation corrigendum published by the EU
items.what: The EU published a corrigendum amending Regulation 2026/1744 regarding the implementation of harmonised rules under the Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230.
items.meaning: As the brand manufacturer under EU product law, technical compliance files for power tools must align with these updated references before January 2027.
items.action: Instruct engineering and compliance teams to verify product documentation against the latest corrigendum text.

items.title: German CSRD transposition negotiations reported as finalised
items.what: Negotiators in the German coalition reportedly concluded talks on the national law transposing the Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive.
items.meaning: Provides clarity on national enforcement and assurance requirements ahead of your mandatory reporting starting financial year 2027.

sources.title: CSRD-Umsetzungsgesetz: SPD sieht Verhandlungen als abgeschlossen

items.title: EUDR customs codes and information system guidance updated
items.what: The Commission released updated customs codes and technical guidance for the EUDR Information System ahead of the regulation's planned application.
items.meaning: Relevant if any imported equipment includes timber components or wood-fibre packaging requiring due diligence declarations at customs.
items.action: Confirm whether finished tool packaging or components fall under the updated EUDR customs codes.
